lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiZn2Fe4O8 (reduced formula LiZn2(FeO2)4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors, while Li is coordinated by five O neighbors and Zn by four; each O center has three neighbors. The Fe-centered octahedra show corner- and edge-sharing, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
